The stairs are a 4-block-wide row at spawn-relative (5-8, 0, 2) at the entrance of a stone brick building. Target is set to the center of the row at [7, 0, 2]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the stairs rather than facing away.

The cobblestone stairs form a 4-block-wide staircase leading to the building entrance, clearly visible with their stepped profile against the grass ground.

Three torches provide lighting. The stairs are ~7 blocks from spawn diagonally, reachable within 10-15 steps.
